verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents a Metrics Explorer for ad hoc querying with a visual builder or established query languages, PromQL and ClickHouse SQL (signoz-docs-11). Logs and traces can be searched, filtered and analyzed by any attribute (signoz-docs-3, signoz-docs-7), and ClickHouse queries can be written across traces, logs and metrics (signoz-docs-24). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a query language for ad hoc log and trace analysis (beyond filters), an in-depth query-language reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of the query experience.
